quote: The amendments made by this section shall apply to fuel use or air transportation after September 30, 2005.
why: Each SAFETEA-LU amendment to section 4261 (secs. 11121-11123) applies only to transportation after September 30, 2005, after the August 10, 2005 enactment.

quote: Except as provided in subsection (b), the amendments made by this subtitle shall take effect as of October 13, 1994.
why: Section 311(5) is a technical amendment to USERRA (subtitle B) made effective as of USERRA's own enactment date, October 13, 1994.

quote: This title and the amendments made by this title shall apply to any application for registration of a trademark pending on, or filed on or after, the effective date of this Act.
why: Section 104 takes effect one year after enactment (or on Trademark Law Treaty entry into force) and reaches applications already pending on that date.
The only effective-date provision (sec. 8(b)) covers section 207 (25 U.S.C. 2206), so the section 202 definition amendments take effect on enactment, October 27, 2004.

quote: the provisions of this Act and the amendments made by this Act take effect on the date the Agreement enters into force.
why: Section 204's amendment to 19 U.S.C. 1592(c) takes effect when the US-Singapore FTA enters into force (January 1, 2004), after enactment.

quote: This Act and the amendments made by this Act shall become effective on January 1, 2009.
why: The ADA Amendments Act sets a single future effective date of January 1, 2009, with no reach-back language.
The Voting Rights Act reauthorization has no effective-date provision, so the amendments to section 4 take effect on approval, July 27, 2006.

quote: The amendments made by this section shall take effect on the date of enactment of the Agricultural Research, Extension, and Education Reform Act of 1998.
why: Section 753(a) amends text added by AREERA section 253(b) and is made effective as of AREERA's enactment (June 23, 1998), before this law's October 21, 1998 approval.

quote: the amendments made by this section shall apply to taxable years ending after May 6, 1997.
why: The section 311 rewrite of section 1(h) applies to taxable years ending after May 6, 1997, reaching gains realized before the August 5, 1997 enactment.

quote: The amendments made by subsections (b) and (c)(1) shall apply to underpayments attributable to transactions entered into after the date of the enactment of this Act.
why: Section 1409(e) limits the section 6664 amendments to underpayments and understatements from transactions entered into after March 30, 2010.
